title: Indian Stroke Speech Corpus
task: sustained vowels; plosive-vowel words; phonetically rich three-word sentence reading
token_or_recording_size: 50 stroke patients + 50 healthy controls; five sustained vowels twice per speaker plus words and sentence sets
annotation_target: manually segmented vowel-category utterances and sentence utterances; F0/duration analyses
manual_scope: paper explicitly states raw audio recordings were manually segmented to generate independent utterances for each vowel category and similarly for sentences
decision_reason: Primary clinical production recordings with explicit manual utterance segmentation and a public Zenodo deposit; suitable for vowel-level production analysis and clinical/healthy comparisons.
evidence_summary: Scientific Reports methods report primary recordings at AIIMS Mangalagiri from 50 stroke patients and 50 controls, 44.1-kHz iPad capture, manual segmentation of raw audio into independent vowel-category utterances and sentence utterances, and public deposition as Indian Stroke Speech Corpus on Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15675906 (record 15675907).
